0022600033.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-7, 5th in the Pacific and 15th in the West) host the San Antonio Spurs (6-2, 2nd in the Southwest, riding a six-game winning streak) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C matchup, the Kings' ninth game of the season. The Kings are without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while the Spurs are missing Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain). Sacramento trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 130-103 loss in San Antonio, and it was also swept 0-3 by the Spurs in 2025-26.
